Release notes _Sourced from [Microsoft.Extensions.AI's releases](https://github.com/dotnet/extensions/releases)._ ## 10.11.0 # .NET Extensions 10.11.0 This release adds optional scope capture for buffered logs and updates experimental HTTP latency enrichment APIs. It remains experimental under `EXTEXP0013` in this release. #​7730 ## What's Changed ### AI * Yield final image when streaming with HostedImageGenerationTool #​7774 by @​iamAdarshh * Make the default tool-rejection message state that the decision is final #​7784 by @​manjunathshiva * AI: Remove obsolete OpenAI JsonPatch workaround #​7815 by @​jozkee (co-authored by @​Copilot) * Ignore empty model IDs in streaming responses #​7816 by @​valkiara * Honor FunctionInvocationContext.Terminate when the function throws #​7801 by @​gjz22 * Fix ChatResponseUpdate.Clone dropping ContinuationToken #​7699 by @​dfedoryshchev * Decode non-base64 data URIs in DataContent to the octets they encode #​7798 by @​Laurianti ### AI Evaluation * [M.E.AI.Evaluation.Reporting] Fix context and metric interpretation visualization #​7738 by @​grafanaKibana * Fix tokenizer attaching punctuation to number tokens #​7766 by @​tahakocal * Order iteration results numerically #​7769 by @​tahakocal * Score GLEU against the best matching reference #​7768 by @​tahakocal ### Telemetry and Observability * Optionally preserve logging scopes in buffered log records #​7813 by @​evgenyfedorov2 (co-authored by @​Copilot) * Fix OOM from unbounded enumeration of ExtendedLogger tag joiners #​7819 by @​evgenyfedorov2 (co-authored by @​Copilot) * Fix log buffering race by removing the rule selector cache #​7803 by @​evgenyfedorov2 (co-authored by @​Copilot) ### ASP.NET Core Extensions * Rename AddHttpLatencyTelemetry to AddHttpServerLatencyTelemetry (API-approved shape) #​7730 by @​EasyL0ver (co-authored by @​Copilot) * Fix ArgumentNullException in per-request log buffering at the end of a request #​7811 by @​evgenyfedorov2 (co-authored by @​Copilot) ### AI Project Templates * Align aichatweb local vector-store keys with Guid record keys #​7804 by @​jongalloway (co-authored by @​adamsitnik @​Copilot) ### Caching ...
